label: Codex on the Flight of Birds
summary: Small notebook on bird flight and flying machines, Biblioteca Reale, Turin, class mark Varia 95.
history: given to the House of Savoy 31 December 1893

claims.statement: The codex was uncatalogued until February 1970, when it received the class mark Varia 95.
